rule.title: A Form 1099-K reported entirely in error, or for personal items sold at a loss, counts nothing

citation.wording: If the entire amount reported to you on Form(s) 1099-K was in error or for personal items sold at a loss, enter the total amount from Form(s) 1099-K, box 1(a), in the entry space at the top of Schedule 1.

rule.open_point: When only part of box 1a was in error, that part is entered at the top of Schedule 1 by the preparer; it is not applied here.
